title: Cart total only reflects first item price
description: When two products are added to MiniShop's cart, the total shows only the first item's price instead of the sum of both. For example, adding Keyboard ($10) and Mouse Pad ($20) shows $10.00 instead of $30.00.

steps: Click 'Add to Cart' for Mouse Pad ($20.00)
Observe the cart total displayed on the page
reproduction.actual: Cart total displays $10.00 (only first item price)

lastRun.actual: MiniShop is not running at port 5174

patch.summary: Fix cart total by using reduce to sum all item prices instead of reading only the first item
patch.reasoning: The cartStore.ts computed the total by accessing items[0].price directly instead of iterating over all cart items. Replacing the direct index access with Array.reduce ensures all item prices are summed, producing the correct total regardless of how many items are in the cart.

beforeRun.actual: MiniShop is not running at port 5174

evidence.description: Screenshot showing cart total of $10.00 when two items are added
Raw Playwright JSON reporter output for before-patch run
Raw Playwright JSON result after patch

rootCauseExplanation: The cart total bug originates in cartStore.ts where the total getter reads items[0].price directly instead of summing all item prices. This means the total is always equal to the price of the first item added, regardless of how many additional items are in the cart. Every subsequent product the user adds is silently ignored in the calculation, creating a misleading and incorrect total that could cause users to underpay or lose trust in the application.
